info.name: TechChallenge3 - Authentication
info.description: Registration and login examples for every profile. Successful requests save tokens and user IDs.

exec: pm.test('Created with JWT and identity', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.userId).to.be.a('number'); pm.environment.set('tokenPaciente', body.token); pm.environment.set('pacienteId', body.userId); });

pm.test('PACIENTE token is saved', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('PACIENTE'); pm.environment.set('tokenPaciente', body.token); pm.environment.set('pacienteId', body.userId); });

pm.test('ENFERMEIRO token is saved', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('ENFERMEIRO'); pm.environment.set('tokenEnfermeiro', body.token); });

pm.test('MEDICO token is saved', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('MEDICO'); pm.environment.set('tokenMedico', body.token); pm.environment.set('medicoId', body.userId); });
